title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29621v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon story-driven video generation requires a production agent to coordinate narrative decomposition, state tracking, shot design, prompt construction, rendering, and revision across interdependent scenes. Existing adaptive video systems primarily refine requests or reusable skills, leaving recurring production failures disconnected from persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories. We introduce CineForge, a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples CineForge-Produce for video generation with CineForge-Evolve for cross-story policy evolution. CineForge-Produce organizes each source story into typed narrative, character, spatial, and cinematic states, uses them to coordinate asset and clip generation, and records the process as a canonical production trajectory. translated_title: CineForge：面向长时程视频生成的自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 长时程故事驱动的视频生成要求制作智能体在相互依赖的多个场景之间协调叙事分解、状态追踪、镜头设计、提示词构建、渲染与修订等工作。现有的自适应视频系统主要针对请求或可复用技能进行优化，导致反复出现的制作失败问题无法与跨故事的持久化、阶段针对性的改进相衔接。我们提出了 CineForge，一个自我演化的视频制作智能体框架，它将用于视频生成的 CineForge-Produce 与用于跨故事策略演化的 CineForge-Evolve 相耦合。CineForge-Produce 将每个源故事组织为类型化的叙事、角色、空间和电影级状态，利用这些状态来协调资产与片段的生成，并将整个过程记录为规范化的制作轨迹。CineForge-Evolve 应用“案例-模式-策略演化”（Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution, CPPE）方法来审查轨迹证据，将反复出现的发现整合为有界的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CineForge 是一个自我演化的视频制作智能体框架，通过将视频生成（CineForge-Produce）与跨故事策略演化（CineForge-Evolve）相结合，把反复出现的制作失败转化为跨故事、阶段针对性的持久化改进，从而实现长时程故事驱动的视频生成。
en_tdlr: CineForge is a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples video generation (CineForge-Produce) with cross-story policy evolution (CineForge-Evolve), turning recurring production failures into persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories for long-horizon story-driven video generation.
